structureModel.protocolDescription: Peptide modeled in extended conformation and then minimized with chiral restraints in NAMD ahead of unrestrained minimization and dynamics in AceMD. TIP3P water/250 mM NaCl/310K/CHARMM36m. Note that interactions with periodic self are possible given box dimensions derived from starting conformation. For protocol details see https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkaa991
